verdict.rationale: Yubico documents several public programmatic surfaces: SDKs for .NET, Android, iOS and Python (python-fido2), the scriptable ykman CLI that a runtime probe confirmed installs and runs, and the YubiEnterprise REST API, whose public docs are live at console.yubico.com/apidocs. Together these let a user drive device configuration and fleet operations from code. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec found at the probed docs paths, cryptographic operations require a physical touch that limits fully autonomous driving, and no independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven workflows.
